name: FigJam
description: FigJam is Figma's collaborative online whiteboard for brainstorming, diagramming, workshops, and early product planning.
best_for: Product and design teams that want real-time workshops, visual planning, and a whiteboard connected to Figma workflows.
features: Real-time collaborative brainstorming and sticky notes
Diagramming with shapes and connectors for user flows and processes
Workshop tools including timers, voting, and Spotlight
AI-assisted templates, sticky-note grouping, and summaries
Templates for kickoffs, retrospectives, and roadmaps
Comments, live chat, and audio conversations
Integrations with Jira, Asana, and GitHub
